messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: lift a finite projective plane configuration into the square via affine map

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Lift the projective plane PG(2,3) by selecting a 13-point orbit under PSL(3,3), then apply an affine transformation mapping the configuration into [0,1]² to maximize the minimum triangle area. The conjecture is that this optimal lift achieves a minimum triangle area of 1/132, arising from near-equidistant triples in the affine image. This bound is falsifiable by any 13-point configuration in the unit square where all 286 triangles exceed 1/132."}
